{{Quote|I can guess what you're thinking&hellip; or ''hoping''. But check the magnaband scope&hellip; The vessel we're coming up on is way ''too big'' to be Boba Fett's. And the wrong ''silhouette'' for an Imperial cruiser!|[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], to [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]|<ref name="SW50" />}}
The '''magnaband scope''' was a type of [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]]. It could detect the size and shape of an approaching [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] was equipped with a magnaband scope.
